title: Pawprint: Top Dog
tagline: A pawsitively tiny strategy game from PostHog

text.win: Every park, every walk, every booking: yours. Good dev. Very good dev.
text.lose: The Crashhound buried your bookings. Have a treat and try again.
text.credits: Made with love (and dog puns) for Pawprint by PostHog

rival.name: The Crashhound
taunts: Who is a bad app? YOU are a bad app!
I just crashed another booking. Woof.
Hey! Drop it! That was my bug!
rival.defeat: The Crashhound rolls over. Crash-free walks for everyone.
rival.sprite_prompt: a snarling purple bulldog made of cracked phone screens with a spiked collar

tips: Walker Alley pays out fast. Fetch it early.
Error Tracking trains Bug Hunters that bite nearby bugs too.
Half your bookings stop halfway. Harvest to grow before you roam.
